clips.title: The story
paras: Blackrock orcs hold Stonewatch Keep in eastern Redridge Mountains, turning it against Lakeshire. The Kingdom of Stormwind built and manned the fortress before the invaders seized it as a base for their warlords.

Stonewatch Keep once guarded the eastern ridges and the settlers of Lakeshire from hostile incursions. That changed when the renegade warlock Morganth allied with the Blackrock clan. Strengthened by dark magic, the orcs stormed the fortress and overcame its human defenders. After their victory, Morganth abandoned the Blackrock clan to raise the nearby Tower of Ilgalar and subjugate local gnolls. The invaders kept Stonewatch, turning a former Alliance bastion into a staging ground for assaults on the valley.

A heavy garrison of Blackrock warriors holds Stonewatch Keep under the command of the orc warlord Gath'Ilzogg and his lieutenant, Tharil'zun. From the ramparts, they direct raids across Redridge and take prisoners, including Stormwind's Corporal Keeshan. Stormwind's forces are spread thin, leaving the kingdom unable to send a full regiment to reclaim the fortress. Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris have hired mercenary champions to enter the stronghold and kill the Blackrock leaders before Lakeshire is overrun.
